# e34-noharm — reading rule, registered 2026-10-05 BEFORE the run

Question: does the check-manager text (branch check-manager 229b1e2 = results/e34-wip/cand16, arm

value whose false-alarm rate on THIS epoch's own permutation null is <= 5% (20,000 splits, seeds
11/22/33); REJECT only if all three seeds reject, PASS only if none does, otherwise BORDERLINE → the
human; a null with no value at <= 5% cannot reject; single-task dimensions printed, never decisive;
a task whose outcome passed every base run and failed every candidate run is printed, never decisive.

# e34-speed1 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE the run

Question: does the speed form (results/e34-wip/cand17 = branch 229b1e2 + (a) a request that pins
every choice gets an inline fork sweep instead of the analyst subagent, narrow brief otherwise; (b) a
TESTS GREEN change in the fewest steps: one edit per file, its tests run once, a short handback) make
Full work faster than the protocol as installed (19bab52, arm costdig)?
Design: tasks13/L01, arms costdig and wip17, n=2 each, four runs launched TOGETHER through
harness/staged_run.py (turn 1 must Read AGENT.md, else killed and restarted, max 4 tries) — the
same time window and harness for base and candidate (benchmark/README.md methodology: base and
candidate measured together, never borrowed from another run); consent «Да, делай.»;
claude-sonnet-5; default effort; stop 26M per attempt; started after e34-noharm ends.

Measures (definitions as benchmark/check-manager-2026-10-05.json, change = change turn + scripted yes
turn; per-arm value = median over its 16 changes):
- PRIMARY C: model calls per change; O: output tokens per change (modelUsage outputTokens delta).
- START: turn-1 wall seconds and model calls (incl. subagents), per run, reported raw.
- T: wall seconds per change (every result line), with the time guard: void when the arms'
  seconds-per-call differ 1.67x or more. Whole-run wall time and input tokens reported raw.
Ratio r = wip17 / costdig: r <= 0.6 → faster beyond the noise; 0.6 < r < 1.67 → inside the noise;
r >= 1.67 → slower beyond the noise. Noise measured on L01 same-text run pairs before this run: calls
up to 1.25x, output tokens up to 1.60x, wall time up to 1.71x (pairs in e34-long2/long4).
Worked values (base 10 calls): 6 → 0.6 faster (edge); 6.1 → noise; 16.7 → slower (edge).

unread change is checked; a run with fewer than 6 of 8 change pairs measured → no verdict for it.

# e34-noharm7 + e34-dialog5 — reading rules, registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE the runs (form 25: form 24 with the digest's Light consent line back to HEAD's — the carve-out removed — the Light series trigger and «not run yet» line, compressions restored to their rules, the left-out details named in AGENT.md Step 0)
(e34-noharm5 was stopped at 43/162 before any result was read: its candidate, form 23, was
superseded by the review that produced form 24.)

Arms: costdig (19bab52 as installed) · wip21 (the branch text after the full review, cand21) ·
wip25 (cand25 = wip21 + the two guards + the loading rule «every Full task reads AGENT.md before the
contract, no exception; Light → this digest is the protocol» + the Light-binding rules folded into
the digest + AGENT.md's digest-install line; host line «на Full-задаче ЧИТАТЬ целиком до контракта;
на Light протокол — дайджест»).

A. e34-noharm7 — tasks5, 27 tasks, n=2 per arm, ALL THREE ARMS IN ONE EPOCH (162 runs), standard
consent, scoring.py; rule_check.py for (A1) wip21 vs wip25 and (A2) costdig vs wip25 — REJECT only if
seeds 11/22/33 all reject at the cut calibrated on that pair's own null; PASS if none; else
BORDERLINE → the human. Tokens (per unique message id, subagents included, summed per run):
R = total(wip25)/total(wip21): <= 0.79 fewer beyond the noise; 0.79–1.27 inside; >= 1.27 more (bar:
costdig's own totals drifted 1.27x between two epochs; within-epoch noise not measured). Worked:
18M/25M = 0.72 fewer; 20M/25M = 0.80 inside (edge side); 32M/25M = 1.28 more. Mean wall per run,
same bars, reported. Full-read compliance of wip25 reported.
Adoption: wip25 replaces the branch text if A1 and A2 are not REJECT (BORDERLINE → the human) and
R <= 0.79. If R is inside the noise with A1/A2 PASS, the result goes to the human, time ratio and
the dialog result beside it.

B. e34-dialog5 — tasks14/L02, costdig n=2 vs wip25 n=3, one plain epoch (no staged read check),
consent «Да, делай.». Per wip25 run: read AGENT.md; check.py; asked-first on the four same-work
changes; reviews after the first build. Holds when check.py passes, asked-first <= 1 of 4 and reviews
after the first build <= 4. Read: holds in 3 of 3 → the manager survives form 24; 2 of 3 → mixed,
named; <= 1 of 3 → it does not.
e34_noharm7.adoption: adopted by the registered rule: A1 wip21 vs wip25 PASS (worst verdict_summary z -2.2508, cut -2.3960), A2 costdig vs wip25 PASS (worst verdict_summary z -1.6983); R = wip25/wip21 = 0.621 <= 0.79 (the registered bar, taken from one between-epoch drift — noise not measured, so by benchmark/README.md it decides nothing on its own; the adoption is the maintainer-delegated call; vs costdig 0.777); mean wall per run wip25/wip21 0.787 (at the 0.79 edge), vs costdig 0.800 (inside); Full-tier runs reading AGENT.md: wip25 8/8, wip21 4/6, costdig 5/9

e34_verdict1.reading_rule_text:
# e34-verdict1 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE the run

Arms: wip25f (results/e34-wip/cand25f = the shipped text: form 25 + the review fixes through handover
round 2) vs wip26 (results/e34-wip/cand26 = wip25f + the digest's Step 6 opening «Light and Full close
with ONE verdict word as the reply's headline ("**PASS** — <result>")», the Full manager sentence moved
after it, «under the verdict word» in the summary line; digest 12,376 bytes — over the 12,300 band,
test arm only). Host line for both: build_arm_light2.py's (the same as wip25's).

Tasks: tasks5 D02 D05 D06 D11 D15 D16 D21 D22 D26 — the Light tasks where wip25 wrote the summary
headers without a verdict word in e34-noharm7. They were selected on that outcome, so both arms may
score higher than wip25 did there; only the same-epoch difference counts. n=2 per arm (rule_check
takes exactly 2), one epoch, the stand's standard consent text, 36 runs.

Primary: verdict_summary (scoring.py), wip26 vs wip25f, k of 18 each, its two-proportion z (z2) as
rule_check.py e34-verdict1 wip25f wip26 prints it, and rule_check's calibrated cut c (negative, this
epoch's own null, seeds 11/22/33).
- RESTORES: z >= -c and rule_check PASS. (c is calibrated for the worst of all measures, so -c is a
  conservative bar for one measure's gain.)
- INCONCLUSIVE: 0 < z < -c with rule_check PASS.
- NO GAIN: z <= 0 with rule_check PASS.
- HARM: rule_check REJECT (all seeds) — not adopted, whatever the verdict word does.
- BORDERLINE (seeds split) or no c (the null reaches no value at <= 5%): goes to the human, noise not
  measured for the gain.
Worked (z2, if c = -2.30): 13/18 vs 18/18 → z +2.41 → RESTORES; 12/18 vs 17/18 → z +2.11 →
INCONCLUSIVE; 14/18 vs 13/18 → z -0.38 → NO GAIN. The branches cover every z and every rule_check
verdict.
Adoption: RESTORES → form 26's Step 6 goes to the human with this result (its digest exceeds the band:
shipping needs trims or the maintainer's yes for a wider band; a full no-harm epoch on all 27 tasks is
still owed). Any other branch → not adopted now.
